verse.verse_1: When the sky is rent asunder
verse.verse_2: and hearkens to the command of its Lord, doing what it should;
verse.verse_3: and when the earth is stretched out
verse.verse_4: and casts out what is within it and is emptied,
verse.verse_5: and hearkens to the command of its Lord, doing what it should.
verse.verse_6: O man, you are striving unto your Lord and you will meet Him.
verse.verse_7: Whoever is given the Record in his right hand
verse.verse_8: shall be called to an easy accounting,
verse.verse_9: and shall return to his people joyfully.
verse.verse_10: But he who is given the Record behind his back,
verse.verse_12: and will enter the Blazing Fire.
verse.verse_13: He used to live joyfully among his people,
verse.verse_14: thinking he would never revert (to Us).
verse.verse_15: But no; (how would he not revert)? His Lord was ever watching him.
verse.verse_16: Nay; I swear by the twilight;
verse.verse_17: and by the night and what it enfolds,
verse.verse_18: and by the moon, when it reaches its fullness:
verse.verse_19: you shall proceed onwards from stage to stage.
verse.verse_20: So, what is the matter with them that they do not believe,
verse.verse_21: and when the Qur'an is recited to them, they do not prostrate themselves?
verse.verse_22: Instead, the unbelievers reject it, calling it a lie.
verse.verse_23: Allah knows best what they are accumulating (in their Record).
verse.verse_24: So give them the good news of a painful chastisement,
verse.verse_25: except for those who believe and do good deeds. Theirs shall be an unending reward.
